meta.keys: cells maps each farmland square id (from grid.geojson) to a key in records: the values for a square are records[cells[id]]
meta.low_typical_high: 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile of the seasons 2001-2020
meta.season: named by harvest year: season 2024 = September 2023 to August 2024
meta.how: each source's value is copied from the pixel containing the square's centre (5-11 km pixels; squares whose ERA5-Land pixel is sea use the nearest land pixel), so squares under the same pixels share a record; rain is the median of the sources

rain_month.what: rain in each month, mm (median of CHIRPS, IMERG, ERA5-Land)

tmax_month.what: average daytime high in each month, °C (ERA5-Land)

tmin_month.what: average night-time low in each month, °C (ERA5-Land)

hot30_month.what: days at 30 °C or more in each month (ERA5-Land)

frost_month.what: frost nights (0 °C or less) in each month (ERA5-Land)

rain_onset_day.what: day the autumn rain starts (20 mm in 3 days), counted from 1 September (median of CHIRPS and ERA5-Land)

dry_spell_spring.what: longest run of dry days (under 1 mm) in March-May

hot_days_flower.what: days at 30 °C or more from 15 April to 15 June (durum flowering and grain fill)

tmax_flower.what: average daytime high from 15 April to 15 June, °C

frost_days_winter.what: frost nights from December to February

late_frost_days.what: frost nights in March and April

rain_year_by_source.what: typical September-August rain from each source, mm: shows how far the sources agree

rain_season_by_season.what: October-May rain of each season, mm
rain_season_by_season.shape: one value per season in meta.seasons

rain_autumn_by_season.what: October-November rain of each season, mm
rain_autumn_by_season.shape: one value per season in meta.seasons

hot_days_flower_by_season.what: hot days at flowering in each season
hot_days_flower_by_season.shape: one value per season in meta.seasons

era5_land.name: ERA5-Land daily aggregates (ECMWF, Copernicus Climate Change Service)
era5_land.cite: Muñoz Sabater, J. (2019). ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present. C3S Climate Data Store. doi:10.24381/cds.e2161bac

chirps.name: CHIRPS daily rainfall v2.0 (Climate Hazards Center, UCSB)
chirps.cite: Funk, C. et al. (2015). Scientific Data 2: 150066. doi:10.1038/sdata.2015.66

imerg.name: NASA GPM IMERG Final monthly V07
imerg.licence: NASA data: no restrictions on use
imerg.cite: Huffman, G. J. et al. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree V07. NASA GES DISC. doi:10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07

meta.ai_assistance: Produced by notebooks written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) and run by the Field Shift team in Google Colab with Google Earth Engine. Data values come from the cited datasets and were not written by the AI, except a few published values from the trial at the demo field (its station's rain and temperature, and its soil description), which were copied by hand from Denora et al. (2025) and are labelled as such.
